title: Pt. Leo Estate Sculpture Park
summary: An outdoor sculpture park spanning 16.5 acres, with more than 70 contemporary works and two walking loops at a working winery. Open daily from 11am; last entry 4:30pm.
priceRange: Ticketed; adult, concession and family rates (2 adults + 2 children 12-17); free under 12
recurrenceNote: Open daily; check current hours with the estate
suitableFor: Art lovers; Families; Visitors; Wine enthusiasts
accessibilityNotes: Paved and gravel paths, mostly accessible; check with venue for specific needs
weatherDependency: Mostly weather independent, outdoor sculptures in all weather
nearbyAttractions: Pt. Leo cellar door; Merricks beach; Peninsula wineries
suggestedItineraryPairing: Combine with wine tasting at Pt. Leo cellar door; add winery lunch at Laura restaurant
editorVerdict: An art-led Peninsula stop that gives both dedicated gallery visitors and casual walkers a reason to spend time in the wine country.
editorNote:
Sixteen and a half acres of landscaped grounds wrapped around a working winery, planted with over seventy contemporary sculptures. There is a short loop (1.9km, about thirty minutes) and a long loop (3km, an hour), both gentle, both walkable in normal shoes. The collection is serious: international and Australian work that would not look out of place at the NGV.

The practical move is to arrive at 11am opening, walk the long loop while the light is good, then collapse into Pt. Leo's cellar door or Laura restaurant for lunch. Family pricing makes it the rare Peninsula cultural day that doesn't punish you for bringing kids. Bring sunscreen, hats, and proper walking shoes; the grass is the grass.

Open daily from 11am, with last entry at 4:30pm; check the estate for any changes. Ticketed entry, kids under 12 free, with a family rate for four.
